planOfRecord.rationale: Canonical home for the prompt-manager self-improvement framework: definitions, layer model, promotion ladder, intake pipeline, skill authoring rules, deprecation policy, reference scenarios, the operating-model contract, the three topic-validation pillars, framework-health targets, and the template-convergence loop. Every team's audit and skill work cites this hub. Declared as a root (trailing slash), not a file list: every .md under the folder counts toward orientation cost, so a canon file added here is charged the moment it lands and no second list can drift out of sync. Generated projections count too — a folder is charged for what it contains, so put generated bulk where it belongs rather than in canon.
planOfRecord.useFor: framework canon — definitions of skill/agent/team/PoR/Action/CLI, the layering rule, the promotion ladder, the 10-layer team-member architecture, the intake-collection-analysis-promotion pipeline, the operating-graph contract, topics.json / prose-scan / runtime-attribution validation, and the template-convergence loop

planOfRecord.rationale: Team-level operating contract for the meta-optimization team: operating graph, topic catalog, work item catalog, external inputs, downstream outputs, and recursive improvement loop.
planOfRecord.useFor: meta-optimization team architecture, topic-flow validation, work item-surface validation target, and heartbeat prompt contract

planOfRecord.rationale: Strategic canon for cross-team friction observation: the friction-report taxonomy (scopes, severities, schemas, action-selection, what-is-NOT-friction guard) and the team-level overview of the universal-source friction-inbox flow. Cited by friction-curator/topics.json (intake taxonomy) and report-friction skill (required reading).
planOfRecord.useFor: friction-report taxonomy, friction routing rules, cross-team flow diagram, the second instance of the universal observation flow primitive (mirror of bug-inbox)

friction-inbox/<scope>/<slug>.comment: Universal-source intake (source_team: "*") — any team's members may write via the report-friction skill. The friction-curator drains, classifies the scope, and routes to friction-report/<scope>/<date>/<slug> on the owning sub-member's behalf.

friction-triage-record/<YYYY-MM-DD>.comment: Daily snapshot of friction-inbox throughput: counts received/routed/dropped/reclassified/handoffs, by-scope and by-reporter-team breakdown, overflow flag. supersedesPrevious=true within a day; each heartbeat overwrites the day's snapshot.

toolchain-validator.lane: Validate whether agents are using programmatic toolchains instead of manual fallback work.

skill-optimizer.lane: Convert repeated lessons into skill improvements, Action candidates, Action improvements, or deprecations.

team-agent-optimizer.lane: Improve or retire agent and team structures based on observed performance, including capability architecture gaps across identity, ownership, docs, skills, intake, collection, analysis, promotion, and feedback loops.

run-introspector.lane: Extract durable lessons from recent agent runs, including repeated deterministic operations that should use or become Actions.

actionOpportunitySignals: run repeats a deterministic manual CLI sequence
run searches prose for a command that an Action could expose
run uses an existing CLI operation that is not discoverable as an Action
run fails because a missing CLI forces manual fallback

meta-contrarian.lane: Challenge stale, weak, or excessive open work items. Also this team's shape sensor: hold the team against the target model's deviation catalogue and report deviations; never restructure.

actionReviewFailureModes: Action sprawl when an existing Action could be improved
proposal-only member implemented permanent structure directly

debt-curator.lane: Promote or retire mature meta-optimization synthesis from typed evidence topics. Propose updates to `docs/agent-system/` canon when patterns stabilize. Never edits canon directly.
safetyCriticalRules: Do not synthesize other members' proposals into strategy.
Route accepted implementation to the owning lane.

promotabilityCriteria: stabilized >=7 heartbeats without revision or contradiction

friction-curator.lane: Drain friction-inbox/* (universal-source — any team's members may file via report-friction). Classify scope, route by writing to the appropriate friction-report/<scope>/<date>/<slug> topic on the owning sub-member's behalf, or handoff to debt-curator when classification fails. Maintain daily friction-triage-record/<YYYY-MM-DD> snapshot. Router, not analyst.
safetyCriticalRules: Never originate friction-report/<scope>/* content from your own observations; writes to those topics are only valid when delivering a routed friction-inbox entry.
Never silently delete a friction-inbox entry; every drained entry leaves a record in friction-triage-record/<YYYY-MM-DD> (routed, dropped, reclassified, or handed off).
Reclassify unknown-scope entries before routing; if reclassification fails after one heartbeat, handoff to debt-curator — never direct-edit friction-report/recurring-workaround/* from unknown.
Cap daily inbox drain at dailyInboxDrainCap; above that, emit inbox-overflow triage entry, handoff to debt-curator, and pause further routing this heartbeat.
